## CRM Status (read-only)

`POST /webhook/crm-status` — answers "what is actually in the CRM right now?"

Complements **CRM Integrity Check**, which reports row counts and per-column FILL RATES.
This one reports **distributions** and, most importantly, **how many leads are send-ready per template**.

Reads by HEADER NAME, so reordering columns cannot corrupt the report.
Writes nothing. Safe to run at any time.
